title: A researcher's note on one sub-question
description: Facts with their sources, no prose. Bounded: at most 8 claims and 5 open questions, each field capped, so a note stays under 12 KiB of text however a model fills it.

sub_question.description: The sub-question this note answers, with its id, as the brief gave it.

claims.description: The strongest facts found, each backed by a page that was fetched.

url.description: The page the fact is on.

quote.description: The words on that page that state it, copied exactly.

accessed.description: The day the page was fetched, YYYY-MM-DD.

open_questions.description: What could not be backed by a source, or what the sources leave open.
